evidence.reason: The current implementation calls `plistlib.loads(source.read_bytes())` in `render_plists` without handling parse failures. A truncated launchd plist raises `pyexpat.ExpatError`, which is not a `ValueError`, so it bypasses the existing exit-1 handler; in `--json preview` mode this produces a traceback on stderr and no stdout JSON error artifact, violating the machine-mode output contract. Wrapping the load and re-raising a template-identifying `ValueError` is the smallest compatible fix.
